     1 | # jobrunner
     2 | 
     3 | Small job runner with a pluggable, bounded exponential retry policy.
     4 | 
     5 | ## Retry policy
     6 | 
     7 | `run_job` keeps its public signature and accepts a `RetryConfig`, a
     8 | `Sleeper`, and a job closure. `max_attempts` is the total number of calls,
     9 | including the first call. Only `RetryError::Transient` failures are retried;
    10 | `RetryError::Permanent` failures are returned immediately.
    11 | 
    12 | Each retry waits for `base_delay_ms`, then doubles the delay. Delays are
    13 | capped at `max_delay_ms` (and a base delay above the cap is capped before the
    14 | first retry). `FakeSleeper` is available for tests so no real time needs to
    15 | elapse.
    16 | 
    17 | ```rust
    18 | use jobrunner::{run_job, FakeSleeper, RetryConfig, RetryError};
    19 | 
    20 | let config = RetryConfig::new(3, 100, 1_000);
    21 | let mut sleeper = FakeSleeper::default();
    22 | let result = run_job(&config, &mut sleeper, || {
    23 |     Err(RetryError::Transient("try again".into()))
    24 | });
    25 | assert!(result.is_err());
    26 | assert_eq!(sleeper.sleeps, vec![100, 200]);
    27 | ```
    28 |
